1. b vy Raengy dy'Ytae khwndn (y'aelf, lm, mym) w y'aevae taemmyy typYt `aeraebynae kw 28. typn, nyshnn l saer y'y`jz qwry'nY kw `aeraebn pY chY nbyt qwry'naek waeky vY chY bkaen, d gael hndY haer j wn Haerfn pYk htyyae y'aewYt y'aew y'khvtn khoe pY chY dkaen.

10. d dlY [daerwwnY] wnd naeskhy haeyae, vYj khwdY naeskhy wn ptr lY kr, w j baer draewkrn wn baerhngry y'yzyaek b y'Ysh krn.
11. w haer gvaek j wnR bYtae goetn: khrbyyY d y'aerdyd naekaen, dbYjn: y'aem tnY qaenjykaer w bshy khwzyn.

13. w haer gvaek j wnR bYtae goetn: dY hwyn jy, waeky khaelkY dy bwaeryyY bynn, dbYjn: y'aem jy waeky naefmn bwaeryyY bynyn?! [hshyrbn] haer y'aewn naefm w pY nwznn jy.

14. haer daemaekY gaehshtnae kaesYt bwaery y'ynyyn dbYjnY: mae jy bwaery y'ynyyyae, w haer waekhtaekY d gael haevlYt khoe yYt shaeytn vaedaerbwwn [mnae b tnY] dbYjn: y'aem haer d gael haewaeynae, y'aem baes tRnaeyn boe khoe b wn dkaeyn.
15. khwdY dY jzyY tRnaeyYt wn daetY, w moelaet hndY daetY haer d khrbyy khoed bzvRn.
16. y'aevae y'aewn yYt baerzaebwwn [tryty] b RstaeRYyyY kRyn, vYj kRyn w froetn [bzrgnyy] wn fydae [qznj] naekryyae w y'aew b khoe jy b saer RYy Rst hlnaebwwyynae.
17. maetael wn waeky maetael wy kaesyyae y'aewY y'graek haelkry [doermndoerYt khoe bbynyt] gv y'gry Roenhy dyyyY, chr knrYt wy khwdyY maezn Roenhyy wn br w hYlnae d tryyaekYd kw y'Ydy y'aew naebynn.

19. [yn maetael wn waeky maetael vn kaesnae] brnaek b RYj w Raeshae`aewraekY try tYd shryqae shryq `aewrnae w brsqyn w vaedn brwysyyn, w j baer brwysyyn w j trs mrnY tlYt khoe bkaenae d gwhYt khoed [baelY dvy znybnae] khwdY b saer bY bwaernd [gwrn] saerdaestae w j wn b y'gaehae.

20. nYzykae [Roenhy] brwysyyY wn koerae bkaet, haer gvaek Roenhy d wn dchn, w gv lY bww try Raeq Rdwaestn, w haekae khwdY Haezkrbyae, d wn j gwh w chvn kaet. b Rsty khwdY l saer haemy tshty khwdn shynae.
21. gaely mroevn, khwdyY khoe bpaerYsn, y'aew khwdyY hwyn w yYt baery haewae y'frndyn, d hwyn bYnae prstn.

22. y'aew khwdyY y'aerd boe haewae daesht kry [kw b kYr jynY bhYt] w y'aesmn kryyae y'vhy, brn boe haewae j y'aesmny (j y'aewrn) y'ynyyyae khwrY, w haemy RaengYt fYqy [boe haewae pY shyn kr] w daery'Ykhstn. y'Ydy hwyn jy chw haevbaern boe khwdY [chY naekaen] w hwyn b khoe dznn [khwdY chw haevbaer nynn].

23. w y'aegaer hwyn j wY [nmaey] mae boe baendaeyY khoe [kw pYGaembaerae] y'ynyyyae khwr b goemnn [kYm kYm] soeraetaekY b tnY waeky wY bynn, w j bly khwdY gzy haemy hrykrYt khoe jy bkaen [bl bYnae hry haewae] y'aegaer hwyn Rst dbYjn.
24. vYj y'aegaer hwyn [vy kry] naekaen w hwyn nkaen jy [chwnky hwyn naeshYn] y'Ydy khoe j wy y'gry bprYzn y'aewY drdwwyY wy, mroev w baer, w boe gwrn htyyae baerhaevkrn.

25. mzgynyyY bdae wn kaesYt bwaery y'ynyyn w kr w kryrYt qaenj kryn kw br wn y'aew baeHaeshtn y'aewYt Rwybr d bnR dhaeRkn (dchn), haer gvaek fYqyyaek jy jY dyY, dY bYjn: y'aevae bww baery nwkae dyyyae mae, w y'aew fYqyyY boe wn dy'Ytae dn (baerdaest krn) waeky y'Ykae [baelY tm naey'Ykae] w boe wn [d baeHaeshtYd] haevsaerYt pk w pqj haenae w y'aew haerwhaer tYdnae.

26. b Rsty khwdY haer maetaelaek bynyt shaermY jY nkaet, vYj [y'aew maetael] pYshy byt yn tshtaekY mstr w pYhaeltr byt, w y'aew kaesYt bwaery y'ynyyn dznn [y'ynn vn maetael w nmwwnaeyn] Rstyyae j khwdyY wn, w hndy y'aewn yYt gwrbwwyyn dbYjn: khwdY ch j vn nmwwnaeyn vyyyyae? [khwdY] gaelaekn pY saerd dbaet w gwmR dkaet, w gaelaekn pY RstaerY dkaet w kaesY pY gwmR nkaet y'aegaer y'aew b khoe y'aew naebn yYt j RY daerkaevty.
27. y'aew j RYdaerkaevtyyYt paeymn khwdY pshty mwkwmkrnY dshkYnn, w haevbaendyyYt khwdY faermn pY dyyn dbRn, w khrbyyY d y'aerdyd dkaen, y'aeh y'aevaenae baerzyn w khwsraet.
28. vYj chw hwyn bwaeryyY b khwdyy ny'ynn? w hwyn d mry bwwn, hwyn zYndy krn, pshy dY haewae mrynyt, pshy dY haewae zYndy kaetaevae, w pshy dY haer baer b wyvae zvRn.
29. [y'aew khwdyY] haemy tsht boe haewae d y'aerdyd y'frndy, pshy baerY khoe d y'aesmny w krnae Haeft y'aesmn, w haer y'aewae b haemy tshtn zn.

30. daemY khwdyY tae goetyyae mlykaetn y'aez dY jhgraekY [jhY y'Yk w dw bgrn] b saer y'aerdy y'Ykhm, mlykaetn goet: y'aerY tw dY wy y'Ykhyyae saer y'aerdy [dnyyY] yY khrbyyY tYd bkaet, w khwynY bRYjyt, w y'aem b Haemd tae taesbyH w taeqdys tae dkaeyn [y'nkw tae j haer kYmsyyaekY pk w pqj dkaeyn] [khwdyy] goet: Rstyy y'aez dznm hwyn nwznn.
31. [vYj khwdY] haemy nv nysh y'daem dn, w pshy [khwdY y'aew nv] y'Ykhstnae baeroek [baer chvYt] mlykaetn, w goet: y'aegaer hwyn Rst dbYjn, nvY vn boe mn bYjn.
32. mlykaetn goet: haer twyy j haemy kYmsyyn pk w pqj, mae j wY znynY pYvaetr nynae y tae nysh mae dyy, b Rsty haer twyy zn w kr bnaejh.

33. [khwdY goet]: haey y'daem: k nvYt wn boe wn bYjae [d bznn kYm znynn], daemY y'daem nvYt wn goetyn [y'yn] khwdY goet: m mn naegoetae haewae y'aez naepaenyyYt y'aerd w y'aesmnn dznm, w haerwaes y'aez y'shkr w naey'shkr y hwyn dkaen jy y'aez dznm.
34. daemY mn goetyyae mlykaetn swjdaeyY [swjdaey slv w RYzgrtnY] boe y'daem bbaen haemyyn swjdae br, y'blys tY naebyt, khoe d psh w khoe maezn dyt [b vY chaendY] bww y'Yk j gwrn.
35. w mae goet: haey y'daem tw w kbnyy khoe d baeHaeshtYd y'knjy bbn w j haer jhY haewae bvYt bY mnaet [baerfraeh] jY bkhoen, baelY khoe nYzyky vY drY naekaen, hwyn dY j staemkrn y'Ynae haejmrtn.

36. [baelY pshy shaeytny y'aew pY hngvtn [d baer khaelaetyYR krn] w daery'Ykhstn j baeHaeshtY] j wY y y'aew tYd, mae jy goetae wn: jY daerkaevn haeRnae khwrY, hndaek j haewae l hndaekn naeyr w djmn, w haet daemaekY dyrkry [l daev khwdY] d y'aerdyd y'knjy bbn w mfyy jY waergrn.
37. pshy y'daem chaend y'khvtnaek j khwdyY khoe waergrtn [w boe khoe pY hyvyy lYnaegrtnY j khwdyY khoe khwst] khwdY lY khoesh bww, w toebaey wy qaebwyl kr, b Rsty khwdYyae toebaewaergr w dloevn.

38. mae goetae [wn] hwyn haemy j baeHaeshtY dkaevn [boe saer y'aerdy], haer gvaek RstaeRYkrnaek j baerY mnvae boe haewae ht [kw ktYb khwdYyae yn hnrtn pYGaembaeryyae], vYj haer kaesY b dwyv RstaerYkrn mn bkaevyt [Roej qymaety], nae trs boe haeyae w nae khaem dgaehytY.
39. baelY y'aew kaesYt gwr bwwyyn w y'yaetYt mae draew daery'Ykhstyn y'aew doejaehynae [jaehnaemynae] w haerwhaer dY d doejaehYd bn.

40. [gaely y'sry'ylyyn] y'aew qaenjyyYt mn d gael haewae kryn bynnae byr khoe, w paeymn haewae d gael mn dyy b jh bkaen, y'aez jy dY y'aewY paeymn haewae b jh y'ynm, w b tnY j mn btrsn (j mn b tnY btrsn).

41. w bwaeryyY b wY ktYb mae y'ynyyyae khwrY [kw qwry'nae] bynn, kw Rsty wn ktYbnae yYt baer daestY haewae [kw y'njyl w taewrtn], w nae gwrYt pYshyyY bn [b vY qwry'nY], w y'yaetYt mn y'aerzn naefroeshn, w prYzkryy mn b tnY bkaen.

43. nvYjn bkaen w zaekt mlY khoe bdaen [waeky mwslmnn] w d gael dchaemyyn [rk`n] dchaemn [faermn wn b shaengstYt y'yslmY htaekrn, w d gael mwslmnn nvYjn b koem (b jaem`aet) bkaen, w waeky wn bchnae Rkww`Y, chwnky dchaemyn d nvYj wnd nynae].

46. y'aew [khwdY trs] y'aewn yYt bY goemn j hndY, kw dY haer baerdaestY khwdyY khoe Rwaestn, w haer dY b bl wyvae zvRn.
47. gaely y'sry'ylyyn byr khoe w wn khYr w khoeshyyYt mn d gael haewae kryn bynn, b Rsty [w hngy] mn qaedrY haewae b saer yY haemy khaelky y'Ykhst.

55. w byr khoe bynn daemY haewae goetyyae mwwsyy: haet y'aem b chvYt khoe khwdyY tae naebynyn, y'aem [d bnyR] bwaeryyY b tae ny'ynyn, j baer hndY brwysyyY hwyn hngvtn, w haewae b chvYt khoe dyt.

57. mae `aewr l hndvy haewae krnae shwnae [kw shY l haewae bkaen] w gaezoe w saelw (swysk) mae boe haewae hnrtn, vYj j HaellY pk w pqjY mae b RzqY haewae kry, bkhoen. w y'aewn [b kr w kryrYt khoe yYt nae d RYd w naedwrst] zyn naegaehndyyae mae, baelky haer zyn l khoe krynae.

58. [gaely y'sry'ylyyn] bynnae byr khoe waekhtY mae goetyyae haewae, haeRnae d vy gwndY [maeqds]d w b baerfraehy w l jhY haewae bvYt jY bkhoen, w chaemndy [khoeshkndy boe khwdyY hwyn j baerzaebwwnY Rzgr kryn] bdaenae joer, w bYjn: khwdYwoe gwnaehYt mae dqwtae, d y'aem jy l gwnaehYt haewae bboeryn w naehYlyn, khYr qaenjykrn y'aem dY ptr lY kaeyn.

59. baelY y'aewYt staem w zoerdry kryn, y'aew faermn khwdY lY kry [kw bYjn gwnaehYt mae dqwtae] b tshtaekY dy yY jY naehtyyae khwstn gwhrt, [vYj j baer hndY] w j baer naegwhdry w j RYdaerkaevtn wn, mae y'yzyaek j y'aesmny b saer wnd brnd y'aewYt staem kryn.

60. bynnae byr khoe daemY mwwsyy dkhwz y'vY [boe haewae] kry [pshty hwyn tYny bwwyyn ], y'yn mae goetY: drY khoe l kaevry bdae [haer kaevraekY haebyt], [pshty mwwsyy drY khoe l kaevry dyy, dwzdae kny jY zn [taemaety haejmr y'wyjkhYt wn], w haer y'Yky kny khoe zny [nysy] [w mae goet], j RzqY khwdY bkhoen w vaekhoen, w d y'aerdyd baer b khrbyyYvae naechn [w naebnae j khrbn].

61. w bynnae byr khoe daemY haewae goetyyae [pYGaembaerY khoe]: haey mwws y'aem naeshYyn bYn khoe l saer y'Yk RaengY khwrnY fraeh bkaeyn, boe mae dkhwzY j khwdyY khoe bkae, k ch j y'aerdy daerdkaevyt: j zaerzaewt w khyr w syr w nysk w pyvzn, boe mae shyn bkaet, [mwwsyy] goet: y'aerY [haewae dvYt] yY bsh [j khwrnY] b yY bYkhYr bgwhoeRn. haeRnae bjYry [haer bjYraekY haebyt] yY haewae khwsty dY boe haewae y'Ytae jh, khwdY Rswyy w bY Rwymaety b saer wnd dRYtyyae, b kaerb khwdYvae vaegaeRyn, y'aevae haemy j baer hndY chwnky wn bwaery b y'yaetYt khwdY naedy'ynn, w b bY baekhty w naehaeqy pYGaembaerYt khwdY dkwshtn, haer j naegwhdry w zYdaegvyy wn.

62. b Rsty y'aewYt bwaery y'ynyy [kw mwslmnn paeykaevtyyYt pYGaembaery] w y'aewYt bwwynae jwhy [paeykaevtyyYt mwwsyy] w faelaeyn [paeykaevtyyYt `ysyy] w sby'yyn [jwynaekae j jwhy w faelaeyn vaebwwynae stYrn dpaerYsn, w hndaek dbYjn: mlykaetn dpaerYsn]. haer kaesY j vn b dwrsty bwaeryyY b khwdY w Roej qymaetY bynyt, w kr w kryrYt chk bkaet, dY j baerY khwdY khoevae y'Ytae khaeltkrn [Roej qymaetY] nae trs boe haeyae, nae jy b khaem dkaevyt.

63. w bynnae byr khoe daemY mae paeymn mwkwmkrnY j haewae waergrty [kw hwyn l saer taewrtY bchn w kr pY bkaen], w mae chyyY (Twr) l hndv haewae blndkr, w mae [goetae haewae] y'aev mae boe haewae hnrty b mjdhy waerbgrn w lY d Rjd bn, w bynnae byr khoe k ch tYdyae w khoe j byrvae naekaen, d bYnae prstn j y'yzyY.
64. baelY pshty vY [dn w waergrtn paeymn mwkwmkry] haewae psht khoe d paeymnY, w y'aegaer nae j kaeraem w dloevnyy khwdY byae, hwyn d Rst j khwsraet w baerzynn bn.
65. bY goemn hwyn dznn k mae ch b saerY wn y'yn [y'aewYt dyynae saer bRyr khwdY], w Roej shaenbyyY daest drYjy kryn, mae goetae wn bbnae maeymwynkYt Rsw w Raezyl.
66. w y'aev szyae mae krae pshvaebrnaek boe khaelkY hngy w boe yYt pshty wn jy, w mae krae chmae boe prYzkrn.

67. boe mlaetY khoe bYjae daemY mwwsyy goetyyae mlaetY khoe: [b Rsty] khwdY faermn haewae dkaet hwyn chYlaekY saerjYkaen, goetn: tw boe khoe tRnaeyn b mae dkaey?! [mwwsyy] goet: y'aez khoe b khwdY dprYzm kw y'aez j naeznn bm.

68. goetn: k j khwdyY khoe bkhwzae boe mae dyr bkaet, k y'aew ch chYlae? [mwwsyy goet: khwdY] dbYjyt: naey pyrae w naey jwnae jy [bchwyk] d nvbaer haerdwyndyae, y'Ydy wY bkaen y faermn haewae pY htyyae krn.
69. goetn: k bYjae khwdyY khoe bl boe mae dyr bkaet, RaengY wY [chYlY] yY chwyae? [mwwsyy goet khwdY] dbYjyt: y'aew chYlae [raengY wY ] zaeraekY tryyae yYt baer lY [b dytn wY] kaeyf khoesh dbn.
